name: Spotify
author: Viboplr
description: Browse your Spotify Music home — playlists grouped by shelf — and search Spotify for songs

apiUsage.reason: Import your Spotify Liked Songs as likes
Skip tracks already liked or disliked before importing

assistant.instructions: Browse the user's scraped Spotify home (playlists grouped by section — Daily Mixes, Made For You, …). Content comes from periodic syncs, not live Spotify. TO PLAY: use the host's home-shelf verbs (GET /v1/home/shelves → POST /v1/home/shelf → POST /v1/home/play) — they handle lazy track resolution and backfill; playback rides other resolvers (usually yt-dlp). These tools are for READING the catalog first: status (is anything synced), list_playlists, get_playlist_tracks (serves the cache, scraping lazily on a miss — can take tens of seconds).

tools.name: status
tools.description: What the Spotify scraper knows: playlist count, section names, sync state, last check time

tools.name: list_playlists
tools.description: The scraped playlists (id, name, section, cached track count), optionally one section's

section.description: Filter to one section name (from status)

tools.name: get_playlist_tracks
tools.description: A playlist's tracks (title/artist/album). Served from cache; an unfetched playlist is scraped lazily — slow (tens of seconds)
